```{r}
#BiocManager::install("dada2")
library(Rcpp)
library(dada2)
#Indicate where the data is
path <- "/scratch/group/kitchen-group/lab/tiana/swifita/trimmed_reads"
filtered_path <- file.path(path, "filtered")
dir.create(filtered_path, showWarnings = FALSE)
#Set the forwards and reverse
fnFs <- list.files(path, pattern="_trim_R1\\.fastq\\.gz$", full.names=TRUE)
fnRs <- list.files(path, pattern="_trim_R2\\.fastq\\.gz$", full.names=TRUE)
#Extract sample names
sample.num <- as.numeric(gsub(".*_(\\d+)V3V4_trim_R1.*", "\\1", fnFs))
ord <- order(sample.num)
fnFs <- fnFs[ord]
fnRs <- fnRs[ord]
sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fnFs), "_trim_R1"), `[`, 1)
filtFs <- file.path(filtered_path, paste0(sample.names, "_F_filt.fq.gz"))
filtRs <- file.path(filtered_path, paste0(sample.names, "_R_filt.fq.gz"))
names(filtFs) <- sample.names
names(filtRs) <- sample.names
head(sample.names)
#Plot sequences quality to see where our reads diminish
plotQualityProfile(fnFs[1:3])
plotQualityProfile(fnRs[1:3])
#Checking the plots
plotsf<-plotQualityProfile(fnFs[1:26])
plotsr<-plotQualityProfile(fnRs[1:26])
pdf("/scratch/group/kitchen-group/lab/tiana/swifita/trimmed_reads/16s_fnfs1-20.pdf")
plotsf
dev.off()
pdf("/scratch/group/kitchen-group/lab/tiana/swifita/trimmed_reads/16s_fnfs2-20.pdf")
plotsr
dev.off()
```

```{r}
derepFs <- derepFastq(filtFs) #gets rid of sim reads 
derepRs <- derepFastq(filtRs)
sam.names <- sub("_F_filt\\.fq\\.gz$", "", basename(filtFs))
names(derepFs) <- sam.names
names(derepRs) <- sam.names
ddFs <- dada(derepFs, err=NULL, selfConsist=TRUE)
ddRs <- dada(derepRs, err=NULL, selfConsist=TRUE)
class(ddFs) #want to see dada or list to make sure you populated the right info
class(ddRs)


pdf("ddFs_Error_Plot.pdf")
plotErrors(ddFs)
dev.off()
pdf("ddRs_Error_Plot.pdf")
plotErrors(ddRs)
dev.off()

plotErrors(ddFs)
plotErrors(ddRs) #could not get these to populate, so I included the code above to save them as PDFs
dadaFs <- dada(derepFs, err=ddFs[[1]]$err_out, pool=TRUE, multithread=2) 
dadaRs <- dada(derepRs, err=ddRs[[1]]$err_out, pool=TRUE, multithread=2)
dadaFs[[1]]
mergers <- mergePairs(dadaFs, derepFs, dadaRs, derepRs, verbose=TRUE) #table of every step how reads have decreased/got filtered out through these steps 
head(mergers[[1]])
```

```{r}
getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
out <- filterAndTrim(fnFs, filtFs, fnRs, filtRs,
                     trimLeft = 10,
                     truncLen = c(220, 220),
                     maxN = 0,
                     maxEE = 2,
                     truncQ = 2,
                     rm.phix = TRUE,
                     compress = TRUE,
                     multithread = FALSE)
track <- cbind(
  input = out[, "reads.in"],
  filtered = out[, "reads.out"],
  denoisedF = sapply(dadaFs, getN),
  denoisedR = sapply(dadaRs, getN),
  merged = sapply(mergers, getN)
)
rownames(track) <- sample.names
track <- as.data.frame(track)
print(track)
write.csv(track, file = "read_tracking_summary.csv", quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
seqtab.all <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)
rownames(seqtab.all)
seqtab <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab.all, multithread = TRUE) 
dim(seqtab)
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab))) # Inspect distribution of sequence lengths --> a lot of them fall in length of 307 which can indicate incomplete merges, contamination, and not true V3V4 sequences, so filter them out (read should be in 400s)

# Filter to V3V4 range (400-430bp)
seqtab.filtered <- seqtab[, nchar(getSequences(seqtab)) >= 400]
seqtab.filtered <- seqtab.filtered[, nchar(getSequences(seqtab.filtered)) <= 430] #DOWNLOAD TO LOCAL DESKTOP
saveRDS(seqtab.filtered, "seqtab_filtered.rds")
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab.filtered))) #Verify lengths 
write.csv(seqtab.filtered, "ASV_table_V3V4_filtered.csv")
```
#Check reads after removing reads that are less than 400 bp 
```{r}
#Sequences and abundances from original seqtab
seqs <- getSequences(seqtab)
lengths <- nchar(seqs)
abundances <- colSums(seqtab)

#Reads by length group
short_reads <- sum(abundances[lengths < 400])
target_reads <- sum(abundances[lengths >= 400 & lengths <= 430])
total_reads <- sum(abundances)
cat("=== Read Retention Analysis ===\n\n")
cat("Short sequences (< 400bp):", short_reads, "reads (", 
    round(short_reads/total_reads*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Target sequences (400-430bp):", target_reads, "reads (", 
    round(target_reads/total_reads*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Total reads:", total_reads, "\n\n")

#Average abundance per ASV
cat("=== Average Reads per ASV ===\n")
cat("307bp ASVs:", round(mean(abundances[lengths == 307]), 0), "reads/ASV\n")
cat("427bp ASVs:", round(mean(abundances[lengths == 427]), 0), "reads/ASV\n\n")

#Summary table
length_summary <- data.frame(
  Length_Group = c("< 400bp", "400-430bp", "Total"),
  ASVs = c(sum(lengths < 400), 
           sum(lengths >= 400 & lengths <= 430), 
           length(lengths)),
  Reads = c(short_reads, target_reads, total_reads),
  Percent_Reads = c(round(short_reads/total_reads*100, 1),
                    round(target_reads/total_reads*100, 1),
                    100)
)

print(length_summary)

#Visualize
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(length_summary[1:2,], aes(x=Length_Group, y=Percent_Reads, fill=Length_Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title="Read Retention by Length Group",
       x="Length Group",
       y="Percentage of Total Reads") +
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(Percent_Reads, "%")), vjust=-0.5)
```


#Assign Taxonomy (ON LOCAL COMPUTER) 
```{r}
ref_fasta <- "/scratch/group/kitchen-group/lab/tiana/swifita/silva_nr99_v138.2_toSpecies_trainset.fa" 
#Download Silva SSU DADA2 trained version 138.2 to species 
taxa <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.filtered, refFasta=ref_fasta, multithread=2, taxLevels = c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class", "Order","Family","Genus", "Species"))

saveRDS(taxa, "taxa_filtered.rds")
```

# make phyloseq object
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
metadata <- read.table("metadata.txt",sep = "\t", header = T)

samples.out <- rownames(seqtab.filtered)
rownames(metadata) <- samples.out

colnames(seqtab.filtered) <- paste0("ASV", seq_along(seqtab.filtered[1,]))
transposed_seqtab.filtered <- t(seqtab.filtered)

rownames(taxa) <- paste0("ASV", seq_along(taxa[,1]))
head(taxa, n=3)

ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(transposed_seqtab.filtered, taxa_are_rows=TRUE),
               sample_data(metadata),
               tax_table(taxa))

head(otu_table(ps))

saveRDS(ps, "032526_phyloseq_object.rds")
```
